title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Ang Pow — Gold Foil Luck. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Ang Pow — Gold Foil Luck
options.lineage: The red packet: Malaysia's universal small gift of hope, folded paper, gold foil
options.thesis: A lottery as a lacquered gift box — quiet, precious, auspicious.
options.viewport: Deep near-black hero; the brand name embossed in gold foil; one cinnabar-red countdown card glowing like a packet left on a table; the six numbers as foil-stamped seals.
options.risk: Red can read loud if the dark ground and foil restraint slip — the discipline is what makes it silent.

options.label: Split-Flap Draw Board
options.thesis: The draw as a departure board: every Sunday, the numbers arrive.
options.case: Strong fusion: the draw reveal becomes a cascading split-flap board — the single most legible way to show six numbers landing; audience identification is the traveler's shared gaze.

options.label: Teletext Results Service
options.lineage: Broadcast teletext magazines — numbered pages on black
options.thesis: The catalog as a broadcast index: results are pages, not sections.
options.case: Fuses plausibly: winning numbers as a 40-by-24 broadcast page with a REVEAL state for ticket checks; risks feeling dated-cool rather than trustworthy-luxury.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What a lottery site ships: neon jackpot glow, confetti, flashing balls — executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement a visitor expects from a lottery site, at full craft.
